info.title: MPLS_LDP
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

properties.description:
Reference Resource: [MPLS_LDP](#/MPLS_LDP)
Reference to MPLS LDP attributes. An emty value indicates ldp label prototcol is not configured on the device. This column value can be empty.

admin.description: The administrative state of MPLS LDP. If not configured, the default behavior is disable

discovery_hold_time.description: MPLS LDP discovery hold time is duration (in seconds) LSR  will keep the peer in the discovered list without receiving  a Hello message.

forwarding_holding_remaining.description: Forwarding holding time (seconds) remaining during graceful restart

graceful_restart_count.description: Number of times graceful restart event has happened

graceful_restart_enabled.description: Specifies whether the graceful restart procedures should be performed in the event of peer or router failure.

graceful_restart_exit_history.description: Last five graceful restart events exit data Keys are from 0 to 4 and values are key/value pair where key exit_reason depicts the graceful restart exit reason Key 4 - Most recent graceful restart exit reason Key 0 - Least recent graceful restart exit reason

exit_reason.description: Graceful restart exit reasons none          - Graceful restart was not started in-progress   - Graceful restart is in progress complete      - Graceful restart is completed not-supported - Graceful restart functionality not supported cancelled     - Graceful restart functionality cancelled

graceful_restart_status.description: Graceful restart exit reasons none          - Graceful restart was not started in-progress   - Graceful restart is in progress complete      - Graceful restart is completed not-supported - Graceful restart functionality not supported cancelled     - Graceful restart functionality cancelled

graceful_restart_timers.description: Graceful restart timers for MPLS LDP

forwarding_holding.description: Forwarding holding time is the amount of time (seconds) that the MPLS forwarding state should be preserved after the control plane restarts.

max_recovery.description: Max recovery time is the amount of time (seconds) that the stale label bindings should be kept on the router after the LDP session has been reestablished.

neighbor_liveness.description: Neighbor liveness time is the amount of time (seconds)  that the router will wait for the LDP session to be  re-established. If the router cannot re-establish the LDP session within that time, the router deletes all the stale LDP bindings received from that LDP neighbor.

router_id.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Reference to Port row containing IP Address of the Router ID. This column value can be empty.

session_hold_time.description: MPLS LDP session hold time is duration (in seconds) an LDP  session will not be torn down in the absence of a keep alive message.

message.description: Detailed reason for error state. Expected empty  when state is 'accepted'

state.description: accepted - Configuration is accepted for processing rejected - Invalid configuration, refer to message            for details

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
